author: Teresa Chapman
text:
We had to have our septic tank located, dug up, and a riser put on.  They did an excellent job and took care of cleaning up the site as well as pumping the tank.

All of the workers were very friendly and professional.

author: Fred Napier
text: The young man that came to  my house was  very present and did the job alone faster than I expected,  he is a asset to your company. I would not hesitate to refer you to anyone that needs work done

author: Eric J. Johnson
text: Great experience with Purge! They were quick to get out for a septic tank inspection and Mike was great at explaining the functionality of how a tank should work and going through signs of when there are issues, what to be concerned with! Very happy with his services and pricing, will be using him in the future! Thank you, Purge!

author: Renae Cavanaugh
text: I was extremely pleased with Purge Environmental. They were very communicative from sending reminder emails to a full assessment of my septic issues following the service call. Not to mention very fair costs. I would highly recommend this company for your septic needs. I plan to pursue further use of this company in the future!! Logan the technician was amazing and answered all of my questions while providing detailed answers and explanations. Mike who scheduled my service call was outstanding, knowledgeable, and patient…I plan to call him tomorrow to ask more questions…lol!

author: Eli Bruns
text: Had them do an inspection for a real estate transaction and it was great! They explained everything they were doing as they went and answered every question I asked. They could have taken advantage of my inexperience and told me I needed the septic pumped, instead they were honest and told me I had another 1-2 years left. Will be calling in the future!
